en: A black-and-white image showing a dramatic coastal scene with a fortified structure on a rocky cliff overlooking the sea. In the foreground, there is a stone pedestal with a potted plant, and part of a bench is visible. On the left, part of a large round tower can be seen. The overall mood is historic and picturesque. The text at the bottom left reads 'DUBROVNIK (RAGUSA)', and there is a number '106' at the bottom right.
